paid.name: Fantasy Props MegaKit, Pro or Source
paid.creator: Quaternius
paid.formats: glTF, FBX, OBJ; Source adds .blend and engine projects
paid.contents: All 211 props (the free tier has 94): more weapons, shields, tools, stalls, chests, carts and banners, worn texture variants and collisions.
paid.why: The anchor kit itself; Mike liked every piece of it shown so far.

paid.name: Medieval Village MegaKit, Pro or Source
paid.creator: Quaternius
paid.contents: All 304 modular pieces (the free tier has about 170); Source's .blend files are the practical way to make the lighter corner posts and doors the game needs.
paid.why: The anchor kit Mike's approved whole buildings came from.

paid.name: Stylized Nature MegaKit, Pro or Source
paid.creator: Quaternius
paid.formats: glTF, FBX, OBJ; Source adds .blend and a grass wind shader
paid.contents: About 116 models: 40 trees with 7 swappable leaf types, 35 plants and flowers, 27 rocks, grass and bushes.
paid.why: Mike likes its broadleaf trees, shrubs, grass and flowers; its pines stay on the fence.

paid.name: Universal Base Characters, Source
paid.creator: Quaternius
paid.contents: 6 bodies in Regular, Teen and Superhero builds, 20 hairstyles, skin and eye shaders; humanoid rig, about 13,000 triangles.
paid.why: The anchor line's people; the Regular build has the natural proportions the free Superhero tier lacks.

paid.name: Modular Character Outfits – Fantasy, Source
paid.creator: Quaternius
paid.contents: 12 outfits from about 70 parts (peasant, noble, wizard, ranger, knight and more), 3 texture variants each.
paid.why: The anchor line's clothing for its base characters.

paid.name: Universal Animation Library, Pro or Source
paid.creator: Quaternius
paid.formats: FBX, GLB; Source adds the .blend rig
paid.contents: 120+ humanoid clips (the free tier has 45): locomotion, combat, swimming, emotes, root-motion versions.
paid.why: Made for the anchor characters.

paid.name: Universal Animation Library 2, Source
paid.creator: Quaternius
paid.contents: 110–130 clips: farming, fishing, melee combos, climbing, zombie motion, idles and emotes.
paid.why: Made for the anchor characters; covers work and social motion.

paid.name: Bestiary – Dungeon Monsters Kit, Source
paid.creator: Quaternius
paid.license: Quaternius Asset License 1.0: game use allowed, files may not be redistributed
paid.contents: 7 armed monsters (goblin, skeleton, demon, lycan and others), 3 colours each, humanoid rig.
paid.why: The anchor line's monsters; its licence keeps the files out of the public study collection.

paid.name: Quaternius Patreon (all Source kits)
paid.creator: Quaternius
paid.price: $20 a month for 30 credits (Source kits about 30% off)
paid.contents: Credits claim Source versions; patrons also get an all-in-one file of every pack.
paid.why: The cheapest way to get every anchor kit's full version at once.

paid.name: Human Basic Motions
paid.creator: Kevin Iglesias
paid.license: commercial use; terms not shown on the page
paid.contents: 404 files: locomotion, swimming, sitting, sleeping, eating, looting, conversations, waving, cheering.
paid.why: Style-neutral motion; retargeting to the Quaternius skeleton is unverified.

paid.name: Human Crafting Animations
paid.creator: Kevin Iglesias
paid.license: commercial use; terms not shown on the page
paid.contents: 322 files: chopping, ploughing, fishing, gathering, hammering, mining, sowing, skinning, watering.
paid.why: Work loops for villagers; rig compatibility unverified.

paid.name: Melee, Archer and Spellcasting animation packs
paid.creator: Kevin Iglesias
paid.license: commercial use; terms not shown on the page
paid.contents: One- and two-handed weapons, polearms, shields, bows and magic, with root-motion and in-place versions.
paid.why: Covers guards, soldiers, hunters and mages; rig compatibility unverified.

paid.name: Ultimate 3D Animal Pack (100+ animals)
paid.creator: WildMesh 3D
paid.license: RenderHub Extended Use: commercial use, no file redistribution
paid.contents: Fox, boar, rabbit, lynx, raccoon, badger, beaver, crow, duck, goose, chicken, pheasant, trout, horse, donkey, cow, goat, cat, dogs, wolves, bears, deer and more; idle, walk, run, attack and death each.
paid.why: The anatomy of Mike's first-choice animals, but with realistic rather than painted coats; would need a painted pass.

paid.name: Single realistic animals
paid.creator: WildMesh 3D
paid.contents: Moose, deer, elk, bighorn, doe, pronghorn, bear and others, rigged with many clips.
paid.why: Same anatomy as the painted favourites; realistic coats.

paid.name: Animals Full Pack
paid.creator: PROTOFACTOR
paid.license: Unity Asset Store licence (no redistribution; must stop players extracting files)
paid.contents: About 24 animals including bear, boar, fox, rabbit, wolf, deer, livestock, crow, pigeon, sparrow, gull, eagle and owl.
paid.why: Natural anatomy in a dated semi-realistic finish, not painted.

paid.name: Forest Animals – Stylized Fantasy Characters
paid.creator: Holotna
paid.contents: Badger, bear, boar, fox and wolf in 15 colours, 4 detail levels, 7 clips.
paid.why: Cheap badger, boar and fox, but anime-style faces and low triangle counts risk a cartoon look.

paid.name: Stylized Fantasy Animals & Bugs Bundle
paid.creator: N-Hance Studio
paid.license: Fab Standard (no redistribution; must stop players extracting files)
paid.contents: 21 creatures including fox, rabbit, beaver, raccoon, camel, ram, cobra, python and scorpion.
paid.why: Hand-painted and broad, but probably more cartoonish than the anchor.

paid.name: Birds and Critters
paid.creator: 3DRT
paid.formats: Unity package (single birds on Fab with FBX and glTF)
paid.contents: Gull, duck, stork, eagle, sparrow and swallow, animated.
paid.why: Covers gulls and waterfowl the free sets lack; older semi-real look.

paid.name: SI – Animated Horse and Foal
paid.creator: Sheep in Try
paid.contents: Horse, foal, saddle and bridle; 41 clips including trot, swim, jump and lie down.
paid.why: Good mount animation; the geometry may look faceted.

paid.name: Low Poly Character – Fantasy RPG line
paid.creator: Infinity PBR
paid.contents: About 30 monsters: goblin, minotaur, gargoyle, mimic, bats, slime, skeleton, medusa, devils, giant worm.
paid.why: Broad and cheap, but sold as low poly; check the previews for facets.

paid.name: Treant and Dragon Monster Pack
paid.creator: Infinity PBR
paid.contents: A treant and dragons with shape variations and many clips.
paid.why: Rare subjects in a semi-realistic finish, not painted.

paid.name: Fantasy creature line (wyvern, dragons, griffon, werewolf, skeleton knight, kraken)
paid.creator: PROTOFACTOR
paid.price: wyvern about $34.99; full packs not verified
paid.contents: Classic fantasy creatures with natural anatomy.
paid.why: Natural anatomy with a dated MMO-style finish.

paid.name: Stylized Fantasy Dragons Pack
paid.creator: N-Hance Studio
paid.contents: Whelp, drake, dragon and elder dragon, hand-painted.
paid.why: Possible drakes and wyverns; likely cartoonish.

paid.name: Fantasy Monsters V2 Full Pack
paid.creator: ENTIGI
paid.contents: Ent, goblin, orc and others, hand-painted (2016).
paid.why: Old hand-painted pack; style unseen.

paid.name: Spruce Forest and Birch Forest – Game Ready with LODs
paid.creator: Silver Delivery
paid.license: creator's comment: commercial use, no resale
paid.contents: 8 spruces and 4 birches with 4–5 detail levels, grass and bushes; about 545 vertices per tree.
paid.why: The strongest conifer lead: painted in the Arcane style on natural species forms, very light.

paid.name: Paint Poly – Cliffs
paid.creator: Silver Delivery
paid.contents: 4 cliffs with detail levels in normal, desert and dark colours.
paid.why: Painted cliffs to match the spruce forest; no rock has a like yet.

paid.name: Stylized Foliage and Nature Pack (bundle)
paid.creator: Cratial 3D
paid.contents: 153 models of 52 real species: boreal, swamp and bog, arctic tundra and Roman garden plants, plus a conifer mini-kit.
paid.why: Real species for biomes the free sets miss; look and triangle counts unconfirmed.

paid.name: Stylized Desert, Tropical, Pine Forest and Forest Nature Kits
paid.creator: Cratial 3D
paid.contents: Saguaro and other cacti, yucca and creosote; palms, bananas and volcanic rock; pines, logs and ferns; broadleaf trees and flowers.
paid.why: Species-accurate biome kits; check the pines and the palette against the anchor.

paid.name: Stylized Tree Collection
paid.creator: Cratial 3D
paid.contents: 18 trees: 6 birch, 6 maple, 6 oak, 3 leaf colours each.
paid.why: Broadleaf species with textured bark; crowns not yet compared.

paid.name: Forest – Stylized Fantasy Environment
paid.creator: Holotna
paid.contents: 3 trees (478–1,610 triangles), bush, ferns, flowers, grass and ivy.
paid.why: Within the nature budget and includes ivy.

paid.name: NatureForge Stylized Woodland
paid.creator: EmaceArt
paid.contents: 388 models: 26 trees, 13 crowns, 21 cliffs, 21 rocks, 75 fences, 14 bridges.
paid.why: Large and cheap on sale; its twisted dark-fantasy crowns may be over-stylized.
